doc.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022

title: Seeking quiet away from work
summary: Gluck says he seeks less stimulation, recalling a quiet week in Vermont versus New York.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Sure. Do you find that you enjoy or seek out silence when you’re not working of course?

Yes. I mean I do listen to music. I like to — well let’s put it this way — I was recently, about a week or so ago we were up in Vermont for a week with just the dog and my wife. The kids are at camp. And it’s just delightful up there. And we listened to music in the car but I don’t think I was listening to much music when we were up in this little ski condo. It was just quiet and it was very nice. I like to joke that since I’m a native of New York City, Vermont has just entirely too much photosynthesis going on and the sound of

all that oxygen being made is just deafening. But yeah, I mean I do seek out — I would say it’s not a question of silence just less stimulation. And New York is quite the visual and aural and olfactory assault at times.
